title: Fanny Mendelssohn's songs under her brother's name
summary: Fanny Mendelssohn wrote over 450 works; six of her songs appeared under her brother Felix's name in his Opus 8 and 9 collections.
why: A major Romantic composer hidden inside her brother's catalogue.

unsung.contribution: Composed over 450 works, including songs, a string quartet, a piano trio and cantatas.
unsung.recognition: Six songs were published under Felix's name; her Easter Sonata was credited to him until 2010.
